title: Vantaris Polymers NV — board minutes approving the Ganymede SPA
text:
VANTARIS POLYMERS NV
Naamloze vennootschap — Uitbreidingstraat 84, 2600 Antwerp — RPR Antwerp

MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS
held on 9 September 2026 at 10:00 at the registered office

Board file: VPN-BRD-2026-014
Subject: Project Ganymede — approval of the share purchase agreement

1. Attendance

Present:
- Mr. Bart Vercruysse, Chairman
- Ms. Annelies De Rouck, Chief Executive Officer (gedelegeerd bestuurder)
- Mr. Olivier Roelandts, Chief Financial Officer
- Dr. Ingrid Schaefer, independent director
- Mr. Rajesh Menon, permanent representative of Solvane Industrial Holdings BV

Apologies: Mrs. Hilde Peeters, who gave a written proxy to Mr. Vercruysse under Article 15.3 of the articles of association.

By invitation:
- Ms. Charlotte Van Impe, General Counsel, acting as Secretary
- Maître Frédéric Dumoulin (corporate) and Ms. Sophie Lenaerts (EU merger control), Roosendaal & Winter LLP ("R&W"), outside counsel
- Mr. Jean-Paul Kaiser, Director Corporate Finance

The Chairman noted that the quorum under Article 15.1 of the articles of association was met and that the Board paper with Annexes 1 to 4 had been circulated on 2 September 2026.

2. Purpose

The Board was asked to approve the acquisition by Vantaris Polymers NV (the "Company") of all issued shares (the "Shares") in Feldmann Beschichtungen GmbH ("Feldmann"), a German company with registered office at Grafenberger Allee 112, 40237 Düsseldorf, from its sole shareholder Heronmere Industrial Partners LLP (the "Seller"), under a share purchase agreement in the draft dated 8 September 2026 (the "SPA").

3. Presentation

Mr. Kaiser summarised the terms. The purchase price is EUR 186,500,000 on a cash-free, debt-free basis under a locked-box mechanism with a locked-box date of 30 June 2026 (Clause 3.4). Feldmann employs some 640 people at its plants in Düsseldorf and Wrocław and generated revenue of EUR 142 million in 2025.

Ms. Lenaerts presented the merger-control analysis in Annex 2. The thresholds of Article 1(2) of the EU Merger Regulation are met; the transaction must be notified to the European Commission and may not be implemented before clearance (Article 7(1) EUMR). Overlaps in industrial powder coatings are below 20 per cent except for offshore anti-corrosion primers in Belgium (about 28 per cent combined). R&W recommended pre-notification contacts on behalf of Vantaris/Feldmann with DG COMP in the week of 21 September 2026. Should the Commission refer the Belgian segment under Article 9 EUMR, the Belgian Competition Authority would review it under Book IV of the Code of Economic Law. Maître Dumoulin confirmed that closing is conditional on clearance (Clause 5.1(a)), that the long-stop date is 31 March 2027 (Clause 5.5) and that a reverse break fee of EUR 4,000,000 is payable if clearance is not obtained by that date (Clause 5.6). The Company's remedy commitment is capped at the divestment of Feldmann's primer line at Wrocław (Clause 5.3 and Annex 3).

4. Financing

Mr. Roelandts reported that the price will be funded by a EUR 110,000,000 term loan under a facilities agreement with KBC as arranger and agent (the "Facilities Agreement"), secured by a pledge over the Shares, and by available cash. The escrow amount of EUR 9,325,000 (Clause 9) will be paid at closing to the escrow account, IBAN BE77 7350 4128 8642, in the joint names of the Company and the Seller. Mr. Duncan Ravensworth, managing partner of Heronmere, has confirmed the Seller's payment instructions.

5. Conflicts of interest

The Chairman asked each director whether he or she had a conflicting interest of a financial nature within the meaning of Article 7:96 of the Belgian Code of Companies and Associations. None was declared. Mr. Menon confirmed that Solvane Industrial Holdings BV holds no interest in Feldmann or the Seller.

6. Resolutions

Having deliberated, the Board unanimously resolved as follows.

Resolution 1. The Board approves the acquisition of the Shares on the terms of the SPA (R&W reference RW/GAN/2026/0283) and the transaction documents listed in Annex 1.

Resolution 2. Ms. De Rouck and Mr. Roelandts, each acting jointly with one other director, are authorised to negotiate final amendments, provided that the price does not exceed EUR 190,000,000, and to sign the SPA and ancillary documents on behalf of the Company.

Resolution 3. The Board approves the Facilities Agreement and the related security documents and authorises the persons named in Resolution 2 to execute them.

Resolution 4. The Board instructs management and R&W to notify the transaction to the European Commission under Article 4 EUMR, to engage with the Belgian Competition Authority as required and to offer commitments under Article 6(2) EUMR within the limits of Annex 3. Ms. Van Impe is authorised to sign the Form CO.

Resolution 5. The codename Ganymede remains in use until signing; no announcement will be made before then, and the draft press release in Annex 4 is approved subject to the Seller's consent.

7. Next steps and close

Signing is targeted for 18 September 2026 at the offices of R&W, Regentlaan 58, 1000 Brussels. Ms. Lenaerts will post the signature version in the data room at ganymede-dataroom.example.com. Weekly calls with Mr. Ravensworth continue until closing. Counsel and Mr. Kaiser left at 11:50; the meeting closed at 12:10.

Annexes: 1. Transaction documents; 2. Merger-control memorandum (R&W); 3. Remedy parameters; 4. Draft press release; 5. Financing memorandum (Roelandts).

Charlotte Van Impe
General Counsel and Secretary of the Board
c.vanimpe@vantaris.example.be | +32 3 555 71 20

Bart Vercruysse
Chairman
